text:
Gold Price in 2011
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2011, the LBMA gold price rose 15.4% between 2011-01-31 ($1,327) and 2011-12-29 ($1,531). The highest sampled price was $1,814 in August and the lowest was $1,327 in January. The mean of these observations was $1,568. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2011:
Gold set what was then an all-time high near $1,900 amid the European debt crisis and the first-ever downgrade of the US credit rating.
